items.title: Remembering Sliman Mansour
items.summary: The influential Palestinian painter dies at 79, the National Museum of the American Latino is still looking for a home, and the new horse mural that’ll put a smile on your face.

items.title: Sliman Mansour, Painter of Palestinian Hope and Humanity, Dies at 79
items.summary: "Our fight now is to tell the world that we are full human beings," Mansour told Hyperallergic in 2023. "We are not less than any other people in the world.”
